project: Airbourne Arena — Ozone Sky Bases v3
quality_reference: vanguard-interceptor-v4.glb — lofted silhouette + tiled diffusion albedo

gameplay_contract.superstructure_rule: command island / citadel / tower mass stays on the -X half; +X launch lane stays clear

surface_inputs.deck: airbase-deck-diffusion-4k-v1.webp scaled to 2048, embedded as JPEG, tiled every 96 m
surface_inputs.vanguard_hull: vanguard-surface-diffusion-4k-v1.webp scaled to 1024, tiled every 120 m
surface_inputs.tempest_hull: tempest-surface-diffusion-4k-v1.webp scaled to 1024, tiled every 120 m
surface_inputs.inferno_hull: inferno-surface-diffusion-4k-v1.webp scaled to 1024, tiled every 120 m
surface_inputs.mapping: world-scale cube projection (uv.cube_project at fixed metres-per-tile); imagery never substitutes for closed geometry

materials.runtime_calibration: calibrateSkyBase() tunes metalness/roughness and emissive intensity only; base colors and textures ship authored
materials.emissive_strength: 1.0 in Blender so no KHR_materials_emissive_strength is exported (r128 cannot parse it)
